title: Create no-op tool for synthetic injection

## File Scope
- **Creates:** packages/opencode/src/tool/ensure-compliance.ts
- **Modifies:** packages/opencode/src/tool/registry.ts (register new tool)

## Implementation
Location: packages/opencode/src/tool/ensure-compliance.ts
Pattern: Model after InvalidTool (Effect-based)
Returns empty output, no user-facing content

## Verification
- Unit test: Tool executes without throwing errors
- Unit test: Tool returns empty/no-op output
- Tool appears in ToolRegistry.layer

title: Write integration tests for enforcement layers
description:
Test end-to-end with LLM compliance/non-compliance, multi-provider coverage, and performance (<10ms latency). Run from packages/opencode with 30-second timeout.

## Story Context
- **Story:** Story 4: Integration Testing
- **Purpose:** Verify all enforcement layers work together and meet performance requirements
- **Contributes To:** FR4 (Zero tool calls are impossible), QR1-QR4 (All tests pass, type checking passes, <10ms latency)

## File Scope
- **Creates:** packages/opencode/src/tool/ensure-compliance.test.ts (unit tests for no-op tool)
- **Creates:** packages/opencode/src/session/llm.test.ts (system prompt injection tests)
- **Creates:** packages/opencode/src/session/prompt.test.ts (response validation tests)
- **Creates:** packages/opencode/test/integration/ensure-tool-call.test.ts (end-to-end integration tests)

## Implementation
Test scenarios:
1. End-to-end with LLM compliance (LLM calls tools naturally)
2. End-to-end with LLM non-compliance (LLM produces zero tool calls, synthetic injection triggers)
3. Multi-provider coverage (OpenAI OAuth, GitLab Workflow, standard providers)
4. Performance verification (<10ms latency for validation layer)

Run from packages/opencode with 30-second timeout

## Dependencies
Depends on opencode-199, opencode-1bf, opencode-329 (all layers must be implemented)

## Verification
- All unit tests pass (bun test)
- All integration tests pass (bun test)
- Type checking passes (bun typecheck)
- Performance tests confirm <10ms latency overhead

title: Implement response validation and synthetic injection
description:
Add validation logic in onFinish handler to detect empty toolCalls. Inject synthetic tool call with toolName: ensure_tool_call_compliance. Update finishReason to 'tool-calls'.

## Story Context
- **Story:** Story 3: Response Validation
- **Purpose:** Detect zero tool calls and inject synthetic call to guarantee compliance
- **Contributes To:** FR2 (Response validation detects empty tool calls and injects synthetic call)

## File Scope
- **Modifies:** packages/opencode/src/session/prompt.ts (lines 1449-1471, onFinish handler)

## Implementation
Location: packages/opencode/src/session/prompt.ts:1449-1471 (onFinish handler)
- Check if toolCalls array is empty
- Inject synthetic tool call: {toolCallId: generateToolCallId(), toolName: "ensure_tool_call_compliance", args: {reason: "LLM did not call any tools"}}
- Update finishReason from "stop" to "tool-calls"

## Dependencies
Depends on opencode-199 (no-op tool must exist before synthetic injection)

## Verification
- Unit test: Empty toolCalls array triggers synthetic injection
- Unit test: finishReason updates from "stop" to "tool-calls"
- Unit test: Synthetic tool call has correct structure (toolCallId, toolName, args)
